conventions.convention: Finite ensembles have N ≥ 1 and fixed nonnegative weights summing to one; zero weights are allowed. Means and covariance are pointwise finite sums, without an assumed probability space or empirical interpretation.
The outer product has entries (u⊗v)rs = ur vs; matrix divergence is rowwise. The covariance contribution in the averaged equation is −div R.

The energy balances concern unforced periodic fields on the 2π-periodic torus, integrated with unnormalized Lebesgue measure on [0,2π]^d. Velocities are jointly C1 with continuous second spatial derivatives; pressures are C1; viscosity is a common constant ν ≥ 0.
A:∇q means the sum of Ars times ∂xs qr. The transfer integral enters mean energy positively and fluctuation energy negatively; neither its sign nor a preferred transfer direction is asserted.

The refuted determination claim ranges over the entire stated class of ensembles with fixed d ≥ 2 and ν ≥ 0, allowing member counts and weights to vary; equality concerns both complete mean velocity and mean pressure fields.

load_bearing.statement: For a finite family of divergence-free velocities jointly C1 with continuous second spatial derivatives, C1 pressures and continuous forcings on an open time interval and open spatial domain, satisfying the displayed equations with fixed normalized nonnegative weights and common ν ≥ 0, the mean satisfies ∂t ū + div(ū⊗ū) + ∇p̄ = νΔū + f̄ − div R. Fluctuations have zero weighted mean, the weighted quadratic tensor splits as ū⊗ū + R, R is symmetric positive semidefinite, and Σj aj|uj|² = |ū|² + tr R.
For fixed weights aj ≥ 0 summing to one, X̄ = Σj ajXj, X′j = Xj − X̄, and C(X,Y) = Σj aj X′j⊗Y′j; covariance is C(X,X). For functions, these formulas apply pointwise using the same fixed weights.

seams_checked.note: Checked fd-c02's page prerequisite and its remark's actual citation against the fd-c01 supplier. The remark specializes to d = 3 while preserving regularity, fixed weights, common viscosity, forcing and the −div R sign. It explicitly separates this finite identity from temporal averages, probability expectations, empirical observations and closure assumptions. The supplier makes no converse claim or dependency on fd-c02.
